Title: Try Azure Service Fabric for free

Body.Content: Party Clusters are public and open Service Fabric clusters that are hosted on Azure and run by the Service Fabric team. Anyone can deploy applications and learn about the platform at no cost. No subscriptions or sign-ups are required. Join a Party Cluster today, deploy any application you like, and give Service Fabric a try for free.
